# Stat audit

*Generated by `npm run stat-audit`. The assertions behind these numbers are `tests/audit/*.test.ts`. The code wins wherever this note and the code disagree.*

## 1. Strict economy: gold per second from a flat base of 1000

Character: fresh (all attributes 5, which already gives the full-value stat bonus, +25 % on gold). Embers are the lifetime Embers earned.

## 5. What the server does with cheating saves

Each row is a second save sent through the real `acceptSave` against an honest first save (in-memory store). *Rate factor* is the gold income the server stored for that save divided by an honest save's: above 1 the cheat now pays out in offline income and kill rewards, because the server derives both from the stored save.

| Cheat | Verdict | Flags / reason | Rate factor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,000,000 Embers and rebirth 1, at castle 1 with 12 tiles | CLAMPED | ember_jump | x1 |
| a brand new account whose first save holds 1,000,000 Embers | CLAMPED | ember_jump | x1 |
| rebirth count 0 -> 40 in one save, 900,000 Embers | CLAMPED | ember_jump | x1 |
| Thrift level 10 without spending the Embers | REJECTED | The save contains impossible data (embers do not add up). | - |
| +100 attribute points | SILENT | none | x1 |
| click ladder maxed | SILENT | none | x1 |
| 1e12 XP | CLAMPED | xp_jump | x1 |
| 1e12 gold | CLAMPED | gold_jump, networth_exceeds | x1 |
| +1,500 gold in 300 s (inside the 1,000 floor + income allowance) | SILENT | none | x1 |
| +20,000 gold in 300 s | FLAGGED | gold_jump | x1 |
| 1e15 wood, stone, coal and food | CLAMPED | networth_exceeds | x1 |
| castle level 10 with no upgrade running | CLAMPED | castle_jump, networth_exceeds | x1 |
| +1,000,000 s played in 60 s | FLAGGED | playtime_fast | x1 |
| 200 tiles with 100 gold in hand | CLAMPED | networth_exceeds | x1 |
| Foreman 10, Haggler 10, Tithe 10, Bulk 8 with no gold spent | CLAMPED | networth_exceeds | x1 |

- **REJECTED**: the save is refused (`sanitizeSave`).
- **CLAMPED**: accepted, but the server replaces the number with the one it can explain (XP, Embers) or pays the save from the last trusted economy (castle level, rates, merchant levels).
- **FLAGGED**: accepted and stored as claimed; the flag removes ranking eligibility for good. Shadow mode: `ENFORCEMENT.enabled` would refuse the two flags on its allowlist (gold_jump, gems_increase) once switched on; every other flag, playtime_fast included, only records.
- **SILENT**: accepted with no flag at all.

### Who computes what (from the code, `@category Saves & Server` and `docs/plan/14-server-audit-and-data-plan.md`)

| Action | Cost / payout computed by | Server check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Buy tile | client | net-worth floor: flagged `networth_exceeds`, paid from the last trusted rates (**CLAMPED**, IDL-167) |
| Build | client | net-worth floor: as Buy tile |
| Castle upgrade | client pays, timer verified | `castle_jump` (timer cannot beat the clock), paid from the last trusted castle and rates (**CLAMPED**); resource cost not checked |
| Farm animals / upgrades | client | level bounds only |
| Merchant upgrades | client | levels are part of the net-worth floor (Pack Rat excepted); unpaid levels go back to the last trusted ones (**CLAMPED**, IDL-168) |
| Ember shop | client | conservation: unspent + spent = earned (**REJECTED** if not) |
| Rebirth Ember gain | server (`POST /api/rebirth`, IDL-102), the browser as a fallback | the route judges the stored save and records the gain: the rebirth save is capped at exactly it; without the route, bounded by the castle and territory of the previous save, one rebirth per save (**CLAMPED**, flag `ember_jump`, IDL-166) |
| Click gold | client (rate-limited in the browser) | none: no click endpoint |
| Sell resources | client | `gold_jump` (stock held + income + grants; refused once enforcement is on, IDL-112) / net worth |
| Sell / buy gear | server (`/api/inventory`) | server inventory |
| Chest, kill, fight | server | sealed server rolls |
| Offline claim | server (from the stored save's rates) | server clock, cap, efficiency |
| XP | client, bounded by server | clamped |
| Gems | server ledger | replaced by the ledger's |
